title: Tenses
content:
Definition

English: Tenses are the forms of verbs that show the time of an action.
Hindi: Tense verb ka wo form hota hai jo action ke time ko batata hai.

There are three main types: Past, Present, and Future.
Teen mukhya prakar hote hain: Past, Present, aur Future.

Har Tense ki 4 Forms

  • Simple: Basic action (e.g., I play) — साधारण क्रिया
  • Continuous/Progressive: Ongoing action (e.g., I am playing) — जारी क्रिया
  • Perfect: Completed action (e.g., I have played) — पूर्ण क्रिया
  • Perfect Continuous: Past se chalta aa raha ongoing action (e.g., I have been playing) — चलती आ रही क्रिया
Example: Future Continuous Tense - "Tomorrow, I will be working on this project."
Hindi: कल मैं इस प्रोजेक्ट पर काम कर रहा होऊंगा.

title: Present Tense
content:
Definition

English: Shows actions happening now or regularly.
Hindi: Jo kriya abhi ho rahi ho ya niyamit roop se hoti ho.

title: Simple Present Tense
content:
Use

English: Used for habits, routines, and universal truths.
Hindi: Aadat, daily routine, aur universal truth batane ke liye.

Structure

Subject + V1 (s/es) + Object

Example: He plays football every day.
Hindi: वह रोज़ फुटबॉल खेलता है.

title: Present Continuous Tense
content:
Use

English: Used for actions happening right now.
Hindi: Jo kriya abhi ke abhi ho rahi ho.

Structure

Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object

Example: She is reading a book now.
Hindi: वह अभी एक किताब पढ़ रही है.

title: Present Perfect Tense
content:
Use

English: Used to show completed actions with present relevance.
Hindi: Jo kriya abhi tak poori ho chuki ho aur iska asar abhi bhi ho.

Structure

Subject + has/have + V3 + Object

Example: They have finished their homework.
Hindi: उन्होंने अपना होमवर्क पूरा कर लिया है.

title: Present Perfect Continuous Tense
content:
Use

English: Shows action continuing from past till now.
Hindi: Jo kriya past se shuru hui aur abhi tak chal rahi ho.

Structure

Subject + has/have been + V1 + ing + Object + since/for + Time

Example: I have been studying for two hours.
Hindi: मैं दो घंटे से पढ़ रहा हूँ.

title: Past Tense
content:
Definition

English: Shows actions that happened in the past.
Hindi: Jo kriya pehle ho chuki ho.

title: Simple Past Tense
content:
Use

English: To show an action completed in the past.
Hindi: Jo kriya past mein poori ho gayi ho.

Structure

Subject + V2 + Object

Example: He went to school yesterday.
Hindi: वह कल स्कूल गया था.

title: Past Continuous Tense
content:
Use

English: For actions that were happening at a certain time in the past.
Hindi: Jo kriya past ke kisi samay par chal rahi thi.

Structure

Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object

Example: They were playing cricket in the evening.
Hindi: वे शाम को क्रिकेट खेल रहे थे.

title: Past Perfect Tense
content:
Use

English: Used to show the first of two past actions.
Hindi: Do past actions mein se pehle hone wali kriya dikhane ke liye.

Structure

Subject + had + V3 + Object

Example: He had left before I arrived.
Hindi: मेरे पहुँचने से पहले वह जा चुका था.

title: Past Perfect Continuous Tense
content:
Use

English: Action that was going on for some time before another past event.
Hindi: Jo kriya kisi doosri past kriya se pehle tak chal rahi thi.

Structure

Subject + had been + V1 + ing + Object + since/for + Time

Example: She had been working there for five years.
Hindi: वह वहाँ पाँच साल से काम कर रही थी.

title: Future Tense
content:
Definition

English: Shows actions that will happen in the future.
Hindi: Jo kriya bhavishya mein hone wali ho.

title: Simple Future Tense
content:
Use

English: To express actions that will happen later.
Hindi: Jo kriya aane wale samay mein hogi.

Structure

Subject + will/shall + V1 + Object

Example: I will call you tomorrow.
Hindi: मैं तुम्हें कल कॉल करूँगा.

title: Future Continuous Tense
content:
Use

English: Shows action that will be in progress at a future time.
Hindi: Jo kriya future ke kisi samay par chal rahi hogi.

Structure

Subject + will be + V1 + ing + Object

Example: This time tomorrow, I will be traveling to Delhi.
Hindi: कल इसी समय मैं दिल्ली जा रहा होऊँगा.

title: Future Perfect Tense
content:
Use

English: To show an action that will be completed before a future time.
Hindi: Jo kriya future ke kisi samay se pehle poori ho chuki hogi.

Structure

Subject + will have + V3 + Object

Example: By next week, he will have finished the project.
Hindi: अगले हफ़्ते तक वह प्रोजेक्ट पूरा कर चुका होगा.

title: Future Perfect Continuous Tense
content:
Use

English: Shows action that will continue for some time up to a future point.
Hindi: Jo kriya future ke kisi nirdharit samay tak chal rahi hogi.

Structure

Subject + will have been + V1 + ing + Object + since/for + Time

Example: By 2026, I will have been teaching for ten years.
Hindi: 2026 तक मैं दस साल से पढ़ा रहा होऊँगा.
